claims.claim: Multiple sources report that GLP-1 receptor agonists, especially semaglutide, reduce cardiovascular events.

claims.claim: Network meta-analyses also suggest semaglutide has the highest probability of cardiovascular benefit among GLP-1RAs and reduces MACE more than several other agents.

citations.quote: Indirect comparisons of semaglutide with other GLP-1RAs via network meta-analysis suggest that semaglutide has the highest probability of having cardiovascular benefits [17]. Furthermore, a network meta-analysis comparing GLP-1RAs and SGLT2 inhibitors has found that semaglutide and albiglutide reduce MACE more than others, suggesting that they are the most cardioprotective agents [18].

claims.claim: Clinical guidelines now recommend considering GLP-1s as first-line treatment for weight management in obesity to reduce cardiovascular risk.
